verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an API-driven verification service, but the evidence documents only per-session API calls, per-session review actions (override status, blocklist), and reusable flows or static links. A static link that can verify 'any number of your users' is a reusable entry point, not a batch operation over many existing items, and no bulk or batch endpoint or bulk dashboard action is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
